app.title: Paradox Modding Tool
menu.games.heading: Open game in a new window:
menu.mods.tip: Manage the mods of this game: rename, link folders, remove
menu.project.tip: Copy, move or compare the active file between the mods of a project
menu.project.copy: Copy active file to another mod
menu.project.move: Move active file to another mod
menu.project.compare: Compare active file with another mod
menu.project.sync.tip: Compare two mods of the project folder by folder and take over single files
menu.cuTool.tip: Compare-update tool: compares mod files with vanilla, with folding and an optional 3-way merge after game updates
menu.modCompat.tip: Check mods against each other: file and key conflicts, whether overrides make sense, and a report for compatibility patches
menu.compatch.tip: Merge two mods and write the result as a compatibility patch or into an own mod
menu.scriptDocs.tip: Look up modifiers, triggers, effects, event targets and more (from the game's documentation logs)
menu.templates.tip: Create several blocks (and matching localisation) with counted-up numbers from a sample snippet
menu.help.checkUpdates.tip: Look for a newer version on GitHub
menu.help.reportBug: Report a bug in the tool
menu.help.reportBug.tip: Opens a new GitHub issue with program version and system details
menu.help.noRepository: Not available yet: no GitHub repository is set in AppInfo.GitHubRepository.
menu.toolbar.undo.tip: Undo the last program action, for example saving or replacing in files
menu.toolbar.redo.tip: Redo the last undone program action
menu.toolbar.search.tip: Search & replace, also in all files of a folder (Ctrl+F)
menu.toolbar.goToLine.tip: Jump to a line in the active document (Ctrl+G)
menu.toolbar.goToBracket.tip: Jump to the bracket that matches the one at the cursor (Ctrl+B); a second jump goes back
menu.toolbar.scopeFinder.tip: Suggest paths between scopes, e.g. from root to owner.capital; insert with a double click (Ctrl+Shift+P)
menu.toolbar.format.tip: Remove surplus spaces and blank lines or reformat the structure of the active document; undo with Ctrl+Z
menu.toolbar.notes.tip: Personal note on the active file. It is kept in the program, not in the file.
menu.toolbar.bookmark.tip: Set, change or remove a bookmark with a comment at the selection or cursor line; Ctrl+F2 quickly sets one without a comment
menu.toolbar.bug.tip: Create a new bug for the active file or attach this spot to an existing report, with the caret line or selection as the line link
menu.toolbar.splitView.tip: Split the screen into two workspaces
menu.toolbar.explorer.tip: Show or hide the directory overview
menu.toolbar.notesPanel.tip: Show or hide the right panel with the note and bookmarks of the active file
menu.toolbar.autoComplete.tip: Turn the suggestion list while typing (auto-completion of script names) on or off
menu.toolbar.hover.tip: Turn the tooltip with description and scopes when hovering modifiers, triggers and effects on or off
menu.toolbar.launchOption.tip: Launch option for the game (from the active game profile)
menu.toolbar.playset.tip: Playset to launch with (from playsets.json); set as the active playset on launch if different
menu.toolbar.launchGame.tip: Starts the configured game .exe with the chosen launch option
menu.workspace.new.tip: New empty document in this workspace
menu.workspace.open.tip: Open a file in this workspace
menu.workspace.save.tip: Save the active document of this workspace (Ctrl+S)
menu.workspace.saveAll.tip: Save all unsaved documents of both workspaces (Ctrl+Shift+S)
menu.workspace.close.tip: Close the active document of this workspace
menu.workspace.move.tip: Move the active document to the other workspace
menu.workspace.category.tip: Set the category of the active document (overrides the automatic assignment)
menu.workspace.filter.tip: Choose which filter check boxes the document bar shows
menu.workspace.icons.tip: Choose which icons are shown next to the documents

The built-in theme "{0}" is read-only.

Create your own copy now and change this color there?
settings.menu.tip: Opens the settings window. Changes take effect immediately.
settings.window.title: Settings
settings.general.gamePath.tip: Selects the game's .exe (for example EU 5.exe in the binaries folder). ▶ Launch game uses this path.
settings.general.playsets.tip: Selects playsets.json (under Documents/Paradox Interactive/<game>). Needed to pick a playset when launching.
settings.general.storage.tip: Choose the parent folder for "[mod name] Snapshots" and the vanilla history, or (not recommended) store them in the mod folder
settings.general.relearnLoc.tip: Reads the game's script and loc files again and learns which places (object names with suffixes, fields such as text) need a localization (otherwise happens automatically after game updates)
settings.general.relearnScope.tip: Reads the vanilla files again and learns the start scopes of fields (otherwise happens automatically after game updates and new documentation logs)
settings.toolbar.hint: Shows or hides single entries of the main toolbar. Launch option, playset and launch game are under General.
settings.workspace.splitView.tip: Splits the screen into two workspaces (same switch as in the toolbar)
settings.workspace.explorer.tip: Shows or hides the folder overview (same switch as in the toolbar). It is always visible when the program starts.
settings.workspace.bracket.tip: Colors the bracket at the cursor and its counterpart ({ }, ( ), [ ]). Ctrl+B still jumps to the matching bracket when highlighting is off.
settings.workspace.autoComplete.tip: Suggestion list while typing (from 3 characters) and with Ctrl+Space, from the script database. When off, Ctrl+Space shows no suggestions either.
settings.workspace.documentBar.tip: Shows or hides the category checkboxes and filters (with notes/bookmarks) above the tabs
settings.workspace.multiRowTabs.tip: Shows the open documents in several rows instead of one scrolling row (default: off)
settings.workspace.pathBar.tip: Row above the editor with the path, copy, open folder and show notes (default: on)
settings.workspace.scopeStatusBar: Show scope in the status bar
settings.workspace.scopeStatusBar.tip: Shows the scope at the cursor below the editor, with the path to it (field, iterators, event targets)
settings.workspace.scopeStatusBarTop: Show scope below the path bar
settings.workspace.scopeStatusBarTop.tip: Also shows the same scope line right below the path bar above the editor (default: off). Independent of the bar below the editor.
settings.workspace.scopeWarnings: Scope warnings in the text (wavy line)
settings.workspace.scopeWarnings.tip: Underlines triggers and effects that are not valid in the current scope. Reported only where the scope is certain.
settings.workspace.scriptHover.tip: Shows a tooltip with description and scopes when the mouse rests on a known modifier/trigger/effect (from the script database)
settings.workspace.scopeHover: Show scope in the hover tooltip
settings.workspace.scopeHover.tip: Adds to the hover tooltip whether the trigger/effect is allowed in the current scope
settings.workspace.resultsOnTop.tip: Sets whether the search results bar appears above or below the workspace (default: below)
settings.wsToolbar.categories.tip: Create, rename and color file categories and give them extension and folder rules
settings.wsToolbar.filterHint: Same entries as the "Filter" menu. A hidden checkbox no longer filters; its files are always visible.
settings.wsToolbar.iconHint: Same entries as the "Icons" menu. Only changes the display; filters such as "Only with note" keep working.
settings.wsToolbar.filterButton: Show the filter button in the toolbar
settings.wsToolbar.filterButton.tip: The "Filter ▾" button in the toolbar of each workspace
settings.wsToolbar.iconButton: Show the icon button in the toolbar
settings.wsToolbar.iconButton.tip: The "Icons ▾" button in the toolbar of each workspace
settings.notes.visible.tip: Right panel with the note and bookmarks of the active file (default: on)
settings.notes.keepOpen: Keep panel open for files without notes
settings.notes.keepOpen.tip: Without this setting the panel hides for files without note and bookmarks. With it the panel stays open, so the view does not jump when you switch files.
settings.notes.scope: Show scope in the notes panel
settings.notes.scope.tip: "Scope" section in the right panel: scope at the cursor, saved scopes and the warnings of the file
settings.layout.colorizeTab: Color codes tint the whole tab
settings.layout.colorizeTab.tip: Tints the whole tab semi-transparently in the category color instead of only the narrow bar on the left (default: off)
settings.layout.iconHint: Applies to the current theme only. Note and vanilla are colored completely; for bookmark and mod the color fills the badge behind the icon, for bug its border. Mod has no badge without a custom color.
settings.language.hint: Takes effect after a restart. Some older windows are still partly in German.
settings.theme.editor.tip: Create, edit, import and export your own themes
settings.hotkeys.hint: For reference only; the shortcuts cannot be changed.
settings.hotkey.main.guiInspector: Open the GUI inspector (only with GUI tools on)
settings.hotkey.main.saveAll: Save all unsaved documents of both workspaces
settings.hotkey.main.bookmark: Set or remove a bookmark at the cursor line
settings.hotkey.explorer.pin: Pin the selected entry as a favorite
settings.hotkey.explorer.clearSearch: In the search box: clear the search
settings.hotkey.explorer.searchNow: In the search box: search now
settings.hotkey.cu.version: In the version box: apply the version
settings.hotkey.gui.toList: Move from the search box to the result list
settings.hotkey.publish.version: In the version box: apply the version
settings.hotkey.templates.enter: In the search box: next match; in a list field: apply the value
settings.hotkey.designer.undo: Undo in the designer (not in input fields)
settings.hotkey.designer.moveUp: In the tree: move element up
settings.hotkey.designer.moveDown: In the tree: move element down
settings.hotkey.designer.paletteInsert: In the palette: insert the selected entry
settings.hotkey.designer.propertyApply: In the property field: apply the value
settings.hotkey.designer.propertyReset: In the property field: discard the input
settings.progress.hint: This can take a while. Cancel keeps the current state.
settings.update.onStartup.tip: Asks GitHub for a new version when the program starts (at most once a day). No personal data is sent.
settings.update.unavailable: This build has no GitHub repository configured; checking for updates is not available.

compatch.start.writeCautious: Cautious: write only when everything is decided
